cn.assets.groups.title: 管理网关组
cn.assets.groups.scope_hint: 管理当前网络节点下的全部网关组，包括空组。
cn.assets.groups.name: 网关组名称
cn.assets.groups.subnets_hint: 每行填写一个标准 IPv4 或 IPv6 CIDR，至少保留一个网段。
cn.assets.groups.preview_failed: 暂时无法检查网段，保存时会再次校验。
cn.assets.groups.uncertain: 尚未确认上次保存结果。重试会使用原来的资料；如果关闭，请刷新后确认是否已新增。
cn.assets.groups.request_failed: 网关组操作失败，请重试。
cn.assets.groups.save_failed: 网关组保存失败，填写内容已保留。
cn.assets.groups.delete_hint: 删除后无法在页面恢复。仍有设备的网关组不能删除，请先删除组内设备。
cn.assets.groups.empty: 当前节点还没有网关组，可以先新增一个。
cn.assets.types.title: 管理设备类型
cn.assets.types.scope_hint: 管理当前资料所属账号的类型。改名会保留设备引用，正在使用的类型不能删除。
cn.assets.types.name: 类型名称
cn.assets.types.request_failed: 设备类型操作失败，请重试。
cn.assets.types.save_failed: 设备类型保存失败，填写内容已保留。
cn.assets.types.uncertain: 尚未确认上次保存结果。重试会使用原来的名称；如果关闭，请刷新后确认是否已新增。
cn.assets.types.delete_hint: 删除后无法在页面恢复。被设备使用的类型不能删除，需要先修改相关设备的类型。
cn.assets.types.empty: 当前账号没有设备类型，可以自行新增；设备类型也可以留空。

en.assets.groups.title: Manage gateway groups
en.assets.groups.scope_hint: Manage all gateway groups on the current network node, including empty groups.
en.assets.groups.name: Group name
en.assets.groups.subnets_hint: Enter one standard IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR per row. At least one subnet is required.
en.assets.groups.preview_failed: Subnet checks are temporarily unavailable. Saving will validate the data again.
en.assets.groups.uncertain: The last save result is unknown. Retrying sends the original values. If you close this form, refresh to check whether the group was created.
en.assets.groups.request_failed: Unable to complete the gateway group operation. Please retry.
en.assets.groups.save_failed: Unable to save the group. Your input has been kept.
en.assets.groups.delete_hint: This cannot be restored in the interface. Groups containing devices cannot be deleted; delete their devices first.
en.assets.groups.empty: This node has no gateway groups yet. Add a group to get started.
en.assets.types.title: Manage device types
en.assets.types.scope_hint: Manage types for the current asset owner. Renaming preserves device references; types in use cannot be deleted.
en.assets.types.name: Type name
en.assets.types.request_failed: Unable to complete the device type operation. Please retry.
en.assets.types.save_failed: Unable to save the type. Your input has been kept.
en.assets.types.uncertain: The last save result is unknown. Retrying sends the original name. If you close this form, refresh to check whether the type was created.
en.assets.types.delete_hint: This cannot be restored in the interface. Types referenced by devices cannot be deleted; change those devices’ types first.
en.assets.types.empty: This account has no device types. You can add one or leave a device’s type empty.
